1 Present review petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
It is most humbly prayed that the review petition for modifying the order dated 02/02/2024 passed in Writ Petition no. 2537/2024 may kindly be allowed and instead of period of three months the respondent no. 4 be directed to decide the representation of petitioner within the period of seven days from the date of filing of the certified copy of the order passed by this Hon'ble Court. 
It is submitted by Counsel for the petitioner that his grievance would be redressed in case the order under review is modified to the extent that in place of three months time for deciding the representation seven days time may be given the authorities concerned for the said purpose.
Looking the limited prayer this review petition is disposed of with direction to the authorities concerned to decide the representation within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. 
Accordingly, the review petition is allowed to the extent indicated above. The order passed today shall be read in conjunction with the order dated 02.02.2024 passed in W.P.2537 of 2024.
